text: {"label":"Experimental Behavior Analysis as a Discipline","definition":"Work on the experimental analysis of behavior as a discipline, covering its history, future directions, reproducibility, laboratory methods and technology, links to physiology and neuroscience, and its professional society and journal.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Concerns the laboratory research tradition and its infrastructure, not evolutionary behavior-dynamics theory, the general dimensions of behavior analysis as a science, or specific operant phenomena like momentum and contrast."}
